records.text: They are just fighting me for trying to investigate this. But I am in a different place now, and I feel stronger. I want you guys to know that I am ready for this. Just bring it on. We are at Matrix installment two—The Matrix Reloaded. I am ready for these games from these mockingbirds. Okay, Sophia (commenter; surname unverified) writes, “Forcing someone to sign an NDA to attend their own son’s funeral is the most diabolical thing that I have ever heard.” She is referring to tWitch (Stephen "tWitch" Boss)’s wife. I got so many emails about that.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
